method: For every wave51-fix test: parse the TEST html and its rel=match REFERENCE html (inline <style> rules whose selector list hits body / html body / * / body.class, plus an inline <body style>) for any margin* declaration. A pair whose two sides differ in WHETHER they declare a body margin relies on the UA 8px body margin to match; capture-browser-ref.mjs canvasFrameCss injects :where(html, body){ margin: 0 } into the ref side only, so those refs are displaced relative to the test the runtime renders.
